additional_info.subject: 0475788 - ID0475788-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R6 170002153] PowerConverters-Missing Converters in DC4 CRM:00314000260
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre-abi,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0475788.
Today I managed to find the charger not in use and troubleshoot it. Here follows my findings:
The charger has one converter less in DC4, because it cannot read the CAN address of the converter.
I tried to add and remove the converter form the PLC configuration, tried to trigger a converter grouping and reboot the charger, but the CAN address of the converter is not read.
It is necessary to go onsite and follow the next steps:
Because the charger cannot read the CAN address of the converter, I cannot know exactly which converter is. It is either TB11 or TB12, which belong to DC4 group. The other (healthy) converter of DC4 is 2102312VGQKXNA000538. Here is a picture for your reference with the serial number of the converters, so you can proceed by exlusion.
Identify the missing converter, and check if the cables for CAN communication are correctly connected.
If there is no visible issue on the CAN connection, switch the Power converter with another one (TB13 for example), and verify if the  missing converter moves to DC3 or remains there.
If the missing converter switches to TB13 position, replace the converter as it is faulty. If it remains in the same position (unlikely), there is a problem with the CAN connection.
Since an onsite visit is required to further investigate and probably replace a faulty converter,
I am moving the case
0475788
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
